newsitem.title: CROATIA: PRESS DIGEST - CROATIAN WEEKLY TJEDNIK - AUG 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - CROATIAN WEEKLY TJEDNIK - AUG 7.

text.p: Following are highlights of leading stories in Croatian weekly Tjednik. Reuters has not verified these reports nor does it vouch for their accuracy.

- Croatia and Bosnia -- new agreements about old problems. Statements of Franjo Tudjman and Alija Izetbegovic are as paradoxical as relations between their respective states: There are no two other countries needing and abhoring each other so much at the same time.

- Is Croatia facing sanctions after incidents with refugees in Jajce? Germany froze one million marks in aid to the Bosnian town and the Contact Group asked Zagreb to press Bosnian Croats into compliance with the Dayton peace agreement.

- Crime without punishment: Certain political and criminal circles are in league, says former public prosecutor Krunislav Olujic. Political pressure on judges and police more to blame for releasing criminals than poor work by police and the public prosecutor's office.
- Five opposition party leaders announce a meeting to forge a response to ruling HDZ's attempts to break them up. Could the meeting lead to even greater splits between the opposition?

- Interview with Zlata Bartl, retired chemist who invented Podravka's world famous food seasoning Vegeta: There were many attempts to copy Vegeta but no one was ever able to achieve its special taste. -- Zagreb newsroom +385 1 455 7075
